findings.explanation: Net 90 payment terms mean you have to wait three months to get paid for your completed work, which can cause severe cash flow problems.
Net 90 payment terms mean you will wait three months to be paid after invoicing, which creates a significant cash flow risk for your business.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, I have reviewed the agreement and would like to suggest a few adjustments before signing. Specifically: - Regarding the clause "Invoices are payable Net 90.", waiting three months for payment creates cash flow difficulties, so I propose changing it to: "Invoices are payable Net 30.". - Regarding the clause "Payment period: Net 90", waiting three months to be paid after invoicing presents cash flow challenges, so I propose changing it to: "Payment period: Net 30". Thank you for your understanding. Best regards.
